transcript.text: Last spring I was in Beijing for a bit, and I remember chatting about how many rental cars were everywhere.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Funny thing, my cousin kept quoting this beginner class title — "Guitar for Beginners" — like it was the easiest hobby to pick up.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: He actually ended up enrolling Liu Yang in it already, so it turned into this whole family joke about who’s going to practice more.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: And on that same trip, Zhang Wei had already booked a Volkswagen Lavida — pickup was 2025-03-17 for 3 days — so we just went along for the ride.
